output.one_liner: Work management platform enabling CRM, project tracking, approvals, and collaborative workflows with automation.

auth.notes: OAuth2 primary authentication with four flow types: server-side (web), client-side (browser/mobile), username/password, and app authentication. Access tokens valid 8 hours, refresh tokens 28 days. Requires Client ID and Client Secret.

evidence.snippet: The Podio API uses the OAuth2 protocol for authentication. This allows external apps to request authorization to Podio without having direct access to the user's password.
Before you can use the Podio API you must register your application. Your application is assigned a unique identifier, called "Client ID", together with a "Client Secret".
Access Token: 8 hours. Refresh Token: 28 days.

access.notes: Users can sign up and generate API keys from account settings with no mention of cost barriers or approval processes. Dedicated API key page emphasizes simplicity of access.

evidence.snippet: It's easy to get one or more API keys for accessing your Podio data.
grab an API key for each app you want to build from your account settings page.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 1,000 calls/hour standard operations; 250 calls/hour resource-intensive operations. Per-user per-API-key rolling hour limits with response headers for monitoring.

evidence.snippet: The Podio API is a complete programmable interface to all Podio functionality.
The general limit is 1,000 API calls per hour, but if the API call is deemed resource-intensive, a lower rate of 250 calls per hour is enforced.
